div.head: A Table ſeruing vnto both parts of the Chronicles of England, wherein, for thy better inſtruction (gentle Reader,) thou ſhalt vn|derſtand, that the firſt number ſignifyeth the page, and the ſecond number, the line of the page, which in ſome places thou ſhalt finde diuided into the lynes of the Columes, and in ſome other, to followe the number of the whole lynes of the page, ſome pages are by ouerſight eſcaped faultie, which it may pleaſe thee to correct, and ſo vſe it to thy profite.
